title: 第149章 惨案第148章 诱惑啊
lines: 第149章惨案
小火拎着大袋小袋，用肩膀撞开厨房门时，就只有满屋子的香味儿了。
米丽吃的喝的心情愉快容光焕发，挨个翻着小火买的一堆东西，“咦，韭菜呢？”
小火正用力抽抽着鼻子，“这香味儿，这么熟悉，香极了，什么？韭菜，韭……啊韭菜，你找找，我记得买了啊。”
小火目光闪烁，一脸干笑，她忘了。
米丽一巴掌拍在台面，“你说你……”
“算了算了，看看有什么。”盛夏挥着手打断米丽的脾气。
“有豆芽，还有豆腐，你说你买了豆芽还买豆腐干嘛？还有豆腐皮，卖了几天豆浆，你以为你姓豆了是吧？”米丽一根指头伸过去，点的小火上身用力往后倒。
“用豆芽豆腐包做馅？”米丽一个掉头，看着盛夏问道。
盛夏连连点头，其实刚才那半块牛排吃下去，她觉得好象快饱了。
“这什么香味？”小火看着米丽开始洗豆芽豆腐准备做饭了，慢慢吐出口气，往后退了两步，揪过曲灵问道。
“牛排，还有茶。”曲灵还在砸吧嘴，刚才的牛排和茶，是她吃过喝过的最好吃最好喝的东西。
“茶叶和水在柜子里呢，自己沏。”米丽一边快而利落的忙着，一边示意小火。
小火一把拉开柜子，立刻嗷的叫了一声，“天哪，这是哪儿来的？雪芽，满满的灵气啊，这灵泉水，上上上品的啊，哪儿来的？这儿肯定没有！天哪，天哪！”
“你怎么认识？这不是茶叶？这茶叶里面有光？水里面也有，你怎么认识的？”曲灵两只手扒着小火的肩膀，伸长脖子看着柜子里的茶叶和水。
“我小时候喝过，让开让开。”小火一把拍开曲灵，愉快非常的泡起茶来。
盛夏托腮看着小火。
她从前从来没想过小火是不是土著这个问题，她甚至以为老妙也是土著，为此，有一段人生中，她还在大学里选修了古生物学，想研究一下象老妙这样的巨大而神奇的生物，后来怎么没有了……
老妙是她带来的，那小火呢？还有青丘是个什么样的神奇地方？小火为什么从那里出来了？
她很想到青丘看看，也想知道小火是怎么回事，这一千多年，始终保持不变的，除了她的青春，一颗热爱美食的心，就是这份好奇了……唉，好吧，她这好奇心能超过对美食的热爱。
不知道龙头镇怎么样了，不知道邓风来怎么样了，周凯哪儿去了？邹玲在忙什么？马国伟的事，肯定就是卫桓的事，卫桓又搞出什么事了？
还有老妙，忘了问卫桓什么时候把老妙送走了。
盛夏托着腮，越想越出神。
米丽的豆芽豆腐煎饺出锅时，周凯推门进来。
”好香！煎饺？什么馅的？老米的手艺，什么馅都好吃，给我几个，饿坏了，小曲儿给我倒杯茶。”周凯扔掉大衣，一屁股坐到椅子上。
“你怎么来的这么晚？邹玲给你打电话没有？她没事儿吧？”盛夏看着坐到她旁边的周凯问道。
“邹玲没事，卫老板把环贸抵押出去了，你知道吧？邹玲就说了这么一句，说忙得很，晚上过来吃饭再跟你说。好香！好吃！”
周凯说着，已经挟起只煎饺，一边呼气一边咬。
“还有，周局打电话，说那些血鬼四散逃了，问咱们能不能帮忙找到他们，他找咱们干嘛？不是有协会吗？他们跟协会才是一条裤子，这茶好喝！极品，这茶太好喝了，小曲儿再给我倒一杯！”
周凯一边说一边吃一边喝，他真是饿坏了。
盛夏没接话，协会跟卫桓，会不会一山不能容二虎？
“你看新闻没有？说是局部地震，一堆专家在那儿解释，这个构造，那个地质，什么岩石缝隙暗河暗沟，嘿，真能鬼扯。好象影响挺大，龙头镇说是被震的全塌成一片瓦砾了，还有几个镇，那个湖周围，看样子方圆有十来里，都很惨，咱们要不要过去看看？”
盛夏后背靠进椅子里，神情怔忡，这一场灾难，不知道死了多少人，唉，虽然经历过不知道多少回灾难，见过不知道多少回比这惨烈得多得多的灾难，可每次，她都很难过，这次也是。
“对了小夏，你那个活了上千年，到底是怎么回事？”周凯突然想起来这个重大问题。
“不是跟你说过了？就是那么回事。”盛夏有几分没好气。
“那你岂不是……”周凯的话没说完，就被盛夏狠横了一眼打断，“是你祖宗。”
周凯被盛夏这一句话呛的咳的一张脸通红。
“米姐！”院门外传来黄云生那极其好认的声音。
米丽被他这一声叫的胳膊起了一层鸡皮疙瘩，“谁比谁大还不知道呢，谁是他米姐！”
“进来进来！米姐说了，她不是你米姐，叫米小姐！”小火两步窜到门口，推开门，冲院门口喊道。
“是我们老板，让我过来一趟，说是，把老妙接过去？”黄云生在前，马国伟在后，一前一后进来，黄云生脚还踩进厨房，就点头哈腰交待道。
对这个把老妙接过去的命令，十分不解，不过再不解他也不敢问他们老板，让来接就来接吧。
“你们老板在哪儿呢？”盛夏看着马国伟问道。
“在协会那边，说是接了老妙，送到协会。”马国伟冲屋里的人一一点头致意。
盛夏嗯了一声，示意米丽，“把老妙给他，小心点儿。”

Chapter 149 Tragedy
Xiao Huo carried big and small bags and knocked open the kitchen door with his shoulder, only the aroma filled the room.
Mili was in a happy mood after eating and drinking, and her face was radiant. She turned through the pile of things bought by Xiaohuo one by one, "Hey, where are the leeks?"
Xiao Huo was sniffing hard, "This smell, so familiar, so fragrant, what? Leeks, leeks...ah leeks, look for them, I remembered to buy them."
Xiaohuo's eyes flickered and he smiled dryly, she forgot.
Milly slapped the table, "You said you..."
"Forget it, let's see what's there." Shengxia waved her hand to interrupt Mili's temper.
"There are bean sprouts and tofu. Why did you buy tofu when you bought bean sprouts? There are also tofu skins. After selling soy milk for a few days, you thought your surname was Dou, right?" Mili stretched out a finger, lit a small fire and poured her upper body back with force.
"Using bean sprouts and tofu buns as filling?" Mili turned around and looked at Shengxia and asked.
Shengxia nodded repeatedly. In fact, after eating the half piece of steak just now, she felt almost full.
"What kind of fragrance is this?" Xiaohuo watched Mili start washing bean sprouts and tofu for cooking. She slowly exhaled, took two steps back, and asked Qu Ling.
"Steak, and tea." Qu Ling was still smacking her lips. The steak and tea just now were the most delicious and delicious things she had ever eaten and drank.
"The tea and water are in the cabinet. Make it yourself." Mili was busy quickly and neatly, while gesturing to Xiao Huo.
Xiaohuo opened the cabinet and immediately shouted, "Oh my God, where did this come from? Xue Ya, full of spiritual energy, this spiritual spring water, is of the highest quality, where did it come from? It must not be here! Oh my God, my God!"
"How do you know? This is not tea? There is light in this tea? There is also light in the water. How do you know it?" Qu Ling put his hands on Xiaohuo's shoulders and stretched his neck to look at the tea and water in the cabinet.
"I drank it when I was a kid. Get out of the way." Xiaohuo slapped Qu Ling away and started making tea happily.
Sheng Xia held her chin up and looked at Xiao Huo.
She had never thought about whether Xiaohuo was an aborigine before. She even thought that Lao Miao was also an aborigine. For this reason, for a period of time in her life, she took paleontology as an elective in college, wanting to study huge and magical creatures like Lao Miao. Why did they disappear later...
She brought Lao Miao, but what about Xiao Huo? And what kind of magical place is Qingqiu? Why did Xiao Huo come out from there?
She wanted to visit Qingqiu very much, and also wanted to know what happened to Xiao Huo. For more than a thousand years, the only thing that had remained unchanged was her youth, a heart that loved food, and that was her curiosity... Oh, well, her curiosity could surpass her love for food.
I don’t know what’s going on with Longtou Town, I don’t know what’s going on with Deng Fenglai, and where is Zhou Kai? What is Zou Ling busy with? Ma Guowei's matter must be Wei Huan's matter. What happened to Wei Huan again?
And Lao Miao, I forgot to ask Wei Huan when he sent Lao Miao away.
Sheng Xia held her chin, the more she thought about it, the more she became lost in thought.
When Mi Li's fried bean sprouts and tofu dumplings were coming out of the pan, Zhou Kai opened the door and came in.
"It smells so good! Pan-fried dumplings? What kind of fillings are they? Lao Mi's craftsmanship makes all kinds of fillings delicious. Give me a few. I'm so hungry. Xiao Qu'er will pour me a cup of tea." Zhou Kai threw away his coat and sat down on the chair.
"Why did you come so late? Did Zou Ling call you? Is she okay?" Shengxia asked looking at Zhou Kai who was sitting next to her.
"Zou Ling is fine. Boss Wei has mortgaged Huanmao. You know that, right? Zou Ling just said that she was very busy. I will tell you when I come over for dinner tonight. It smells good! It's delicious!"
Zhou Kai said, already holding up a fried dumpling, exhaling and biting it.
"Also, Director Zhou called and said that those vampires had fled and asked if we could help find them. Why is he looking for us? Isn't there an association? They and the association are the same pair of pants. This tea is delicious! It's top quality. This tea is so delicious. Xiao Qu'er will pour me another cup!"
Zhou Kai said while eating and drinking, he was really hungry.
Sheng Xia didn't answer the call. Will the association and Wei Huan not be able to accommodate two tigers in one mountain?
"Did you read the news? It was said to be a local earthquake. A bunch of experts were there to explain the structure, the geology, the cracks in the rocks and the underground rivers and trenches. Hey, it's really ridiculous. It seems to have had a big impact. Longtou Town was said to have been completely collapsed into rubble by the earthquake. There are several other towns. It seems that there are more than ten miles around the lake. They are all miserable. Do we want to go and take a look?"
Sheng Xia leaned back in her chair with a stunned expression. I don't know how many people died in this disaster. Alas, although I have experienced countless disasters and seen countless disasters that were much more tragic than this, she felt sad every time, and this time too.
"By the way, Xiaoxia, what happened to you who has lived for thousands of years?" Zhou Kai suddenly remembered this important question.
"Didn't I tell you? That's what happened." Shengxia was a little angry.
"Then aren't you..." Before Zhou Kai could finish his words, he was interrupted by Sheng Xia's fierce glance, "It's your ancestor."
Zhou Kai choked and coughed at Sheng Xia's words, his face turned red.
"Sister Mi!" Huang Yunsheng's extremely recognizable voice came from outside the courtyard door.
Millie's arms got goosebumps when he shouted, "I don't know who is older than who, but who is his sister Mi!"
"Come in, come in! Sister Mi said, she is not your Sister Mi, her name is Miss Mi!" Xiao Huo rushed to the door in two steps, opened the door, and shouted towards the courtyard door.
"It's our boss. Want me to come here and take Lao Miao over?" Huang Yunsheng came in front, Ma Guowei came in behind. Huang Yunsheng nodded and bowed before he stepped into the kitchen.
He was very puzzled by this order to pick up Lao Miao, but no matter how puzzled he was, he didn't dare to ask their boss, just come and pick him up.
